articles.title: RYBREVANT® (amivantamab-vmjw) longer-term results show promising and durable responses in difficult-to-treat colorectal cancer
articles.mainIdea: RYBREVANT® (amivantamab-vmjw) longer-term results show promising and durable responses in difficult-to-treat colorectal cancer
articles.summary: PR Newswire: RYBREVANT® (amivantamab-vmjw) longer-term results show promising and durable responses in difficult-to-treat colorectal cancer. Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) today announced new longer follow-up results from the investigational Phase 1b/2 OrigAMI-1 study evaluating amivantamab-vmjw, a bispecific antibody targeting epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) and MET, in combination with FOLFOX or FOLFIRI chemotherapy in patients with RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer.
